title: Snoozing alarms on full Android watch
body:
Hi Guys, is there a way of using the buttons on the side of the full Android smart watch (KOSPET Prime) to snooze alarms?
It very fiddly to get to the side menu to choose the snooze option (especially in the middle of the night when half asleep!)
If not possible now, would someone be able to code it?
Thanks for your help.
Ali

comments.body:
Hi @alexmoir1 , i had the same issue with my Kospet watch. Didn't managed to fix it.
I wanted to ask you something,  how many hours lasts the battery of your watch? Since that its the largest battery of all smartwatches.
Eu também gostaria saber alguma maneira rápida de adiar ou cancelar alarmes.

@alexmoir1 Would you please update?
Is this something that can be fixed from the xDrip side?
